description: This source file defines the Kotlin class `NoteDirectEditFragment`, which is part of an Android application for editing notes, specifically focusing on direct web-based editing within a fragment. It manages a WebView for editing notes, handles loading, error states, interaction with JavaScript, and integration with the app's note repository and API.

classes.name: NoteDirectEditFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment facilitating direct note editing via a WebView with JavaScript interaction, handling loading, errors, and editing modes.

classes.name: DirectEditingMobileInterface
classes.description: A JavaScript interface class enabling communication from web content to the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up the Floating Action Button, and prepares the WebView for use.

methods.name: setupFab
methods.description: Configures the Floating Action Button for scrolling and click actions related to note editing.

methods.name: switchToPlainEdit
methods.description: Triggers switching from web-based editing to plain text editing mode.

methods.name: loadNoteInWebView
methods.description: Loads the note content into the WebView for editing.

methods.name: handleLoadError
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar when loading the WebView fails and provides fallback actions.

methods.name: prepareWebView
methods.description: Configures the WebView settings, JavaScript interface, and client for handling web resource events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Handles closing the fragment or switching modes based on user interaction.

methods.name: changeToEditMode
methods.description: Switches from display mode to edit mode by fetching latest note data and updating the repository.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Schedules synchronization of the current note.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to UI elements.

methods.name: onLoaded
methods.description: Callback when web content has loaded.

methods.name: toggleLoadingUI
methods.description: Shows or hides UI elements based on loading state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the fragment or switches to plain text editing.

methods.name: DirectEditingMobileInterface
methods.description: Provides JavaScript-accessible methods for closing, sharing, and indicating load completion.
